chose: The preview is generic and shared: HostPreview in @some-ui/shared, given beats, a seed and a time, draws hostAt's SVG as an image placed by its box as a share of its own area, over whatever it is given to stand on, so the Cast wing and HOST16's signature (in Studio or www) draw with one component. Its time comes from one loop clock per page (useLoopTime): a loop of 6.8 s, two of the idle's breaths so the breath meets itself at the seam, stepped at 15 pictures a second, so a grid of loops redraws together and lightly; held still at 1.2 s where the phone asks for less motion. The loop length and the rate are policy that moves with the story. The burn-ins' HostLayer stays: it draws a frame at the video stage's own pixel units, which a preview does not have.
options: HostPreview and a page loop clock in @some-ui/shared
A preview inside www's Cast components alone
Reuse the burn-ins stage (HostLayer) for previews
Each preview runs its own animation frame at full rate
gray: How smooth the loops look, and how often they redraw on the owner's phone, is a matter of taste and battery the owner sees; no check settles the rate or the loop's length.
undo: Change LOOP_MS, LOOP_FPS or STILL_MS in packages/ui/shared/src/lib/loop-clock/index.ts.
